content:
sasha: FYI ran a tiny canary and Console showed a 4x token blip for 20s, but the ledger has no commit. looks like retry + model-swap + a truncated toolcall. anyone seen this pattern?

joon: can you paste the trace id and whether it was streaming?

sasha: trace=trc_f8a1. streaming reply streaming->client reconnect. model changed mid-request (gptx-small -> gptx-medium) due to canary rollout. also a /tools/fetch_table toolcall fired.

priya: hmm model swap mid-stream is a known edge. our streaming estimator for small vs medium uses different token overheads (system + tool metadata). if the retry lands on medium, the provisional from the first attempt may not get reconciled.

dan: logs: 
```
[router] trace=trc_f8a1 route=ap-south-1 -> eu-central-1 (model swap fallback)
[meter] provisional user=u-770 +58 tokens (est streaming, model=gptx-small)
[meter] provisional user=u-770 +92 tokens (est streaming, model=gptx-medium)
[ledger] no commit for trace=trc_f8a1
```

billing-bot: created billing ticket BILL-3073 for "console provisional mismatch - model swap"

joon: two provisional events for same trace (different models) is the problem. console aggregates them and spikes. ledger never settled because commit was lost in the session handoff. we need linking keys.

priya: proposal A: deterministic provisional key derived from (session_id || request_digest || attempt_seq). router always emits provisional with `provisional_key`. meter dedupes by key and emits a single provisional per key. ledger accepts `provisional_key` in settles.

joon: proposal B: let meter emit `provisional_snapshot` with both estimate and source-tags (model, route, toolcall-hash). Console shows stacked provisional breakdown and auto-collapses duplicates after settle.

dan: operational constraints: router can't always compute attempt_seq reliably when client reconnects quickly. deterministic hash approach is safer. also toolcalls can attach metadata that changes estimates so include toolcall_fingerprint in the hash.

priya: agree. we should also add a `provisional_settle` event with fields: provisional_key, committed_tokens, final_model, trace. ledger will emit this when a commit happens. Console subscribes and subtracts provisional band.

joon: UX decision: don't hide provisional spikes entirely. ops needs realtime signal. but visually differentiate: ephemeral dashed band + tooltip "provisional: not settled" with trace link and age. if provisional persists > 2m mark as orphan and fade.

sasha: nice. also add an alert rule: if provisional > 200% of typical rate for >30s fire P0? maybe P1. ops feedback?

dan: suggest P1. we don't want noise during real incidents. add reconcile job that scans provisionals older than 5m and issues a settle correction (0 or adjust) and emits a reconciliation_audit metric.

priya: implementation plan: 
- router: deterministic `provisional_key` (hash of session_id||req_digest||toolcall_fp) (PR #1221)
- meter: accept provisional_key, dedupe provisional adds, emit provisional_settle when ledger settles (PR #1222)
- ledger: persist provisional index and emit settle events (PR #1223)
- console: dashed provisional band + trace tooltip + orphan fade + reconcile consumer (PR #1224)
- reconcile worker: background fix-up job with audit metric (PR #1225)

joon: tests: streaming + mid-request model swap + toolcall truncated + rapid retry. add end-to-end in integration harness.

sasha: I'll own the console PR and UX. priya you own meter changes?

priya: yep. dan can you add router deterministic key change?

dan: on it. will also add server-side telemetry `provisional_key_mismatch` when we detect two provisional keys for same trace.

billing-bot: linked BILL-3073 -> PR #1221, PR #1222, PR #1223, PR #1224, PR #1225

sasha: cool. we should ship the meter + ledger hooks first so Console can subscribe. timeline: aim to merge within 1 week of approvals. will coordinate rollouts.

joon: FYI we may need a migration script to backfill provisional index for last 24h for debugging; low priority.

priya: noted. adding to PR desc.

sasha: thanks team. keeping this thread open for updates.
